DOM getBoundingClientRect() confirms STRICT NO-OVERLAP on BOTH screens with a comfortable 21.5px gap. Pharmacy: chipTrack ancestor DIV h=56 (y=157), chip 'All' bbox y=166.5 h=37 bottom=203.5, Metformin 500 mg card top=225 -> GAP=+21.5px. Clinics: chipTrack ancestor DIV h=56 (y=64), chip 'All' bbox y=73.5 h=37 bottom=110.5, UTH card top=132 -> GAP=+21.5px. All 4 pharmacy chips (All/Medications/Testing kits/BP monitors) and all 12 clinic city chips (All, Lusaka, Ndola, Kitwe, Livingstone, Chingola, Kabwe, Chipata, Mongu, Solwezi, Kasama, Choma) render with full labels + icons. Chips are vertically centered within the 56px track (chip center = track center = 185 on pharmacy, = 92 on clinics). Clean ~16px separation (via marginBottom: spacing.md on chipTrack) between chip track bottom and first list card. Fix is complete and verified.

rca_of_issue: Previous iterations put height:56 directly on the horizontal ScrollView (via style={styles.chipScroll}). In react-native-web the outer wrapper div for a horizontal ScrollView collapses to its content container's intrinsic height, so the 56px height did not take effect and the 37px chip overflowed its track. Current fix wraps the ScrollView in a plain <View style={{height:56, marginBottom:spacing.md, justifyContent:'center'}}>. Plain Views DO honor explicit height in RN-web, so the chip is now vertically centered within the fixed 56px track and marginBottom pushes the list cleanly below. Verified via DOM: chipTrack ancestor DIV reports h=56 on both screens, and card.top - chip.bottom = +21.5px on both.
